text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: severity P2 — multiple customers reporting sudden overage alerts and spikes in billed token counts. Stack: metering-aggregation. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2270011223

alice-nguyen: I'm on it. initial symptom: customer A reports 3x token usage in last 30m, invoices showing overage. Is this correlated with any deploy?

bob-chen: No deploys in last 3 hours from eng-runtime. I see a surge in ingestion events in the raw kafka topic though — many duplicated messages with identical request_id.

carla-m: +1, looking at the aggregator service (meter-agg). Querying last 15m: ``SELECT count(*) FROM token_events WHERE processed_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY request_id HAVING count(*) > 1`` returns ~12k dup groups.

alice-nguyen: that explains drift. If duplicates made it past dedupe stage, downstream counting will overshoot. Any clue where duplicates originate? producer or broker?

bob-chen: brokers show repeated acks. Could be the producer retry loop not honoring idempotence header after a transient. Checking producer logs from ingest-gateway-*.

metering-bot: alert: "dedupe_failure_rate" increased to 7% at 2026-03-15T09:02:10Z for metering-aggregation (threshold 1%).

dave-billing: Customer impact: support ticket thread shows 14 customers got overage flags, 5 had alerts auto-escalated. We should suppress overage emails until we confirm. Can we throttle alerting?

eve-support: Please confirm ASAP — customers are pinging support slack channel and some are pausing usage. We need a rapid statement.

alice-nguyen: Mitigation plan: (1) pause overage alert emails (dave, can you flip the flag?), (2) enable aggressive dedupe fallback in metering-agg (sre-oncall help deploy), (3) start a live recon run to identify affected accounts and mark them for credit hold.

sre-oncall: I can push a hotfix to enable dedupe fallback (set ENV METERING_DEDUPE_STRICT=false) to avoid reject path. Will run canary in us-west first.

bob-chen: I found producer logs showing HTTP 500 retries from a new ingress node (ingress-23) around 08:51 that retried with same request_id but without idempotency token. Looks like a recent autoscaled instance had a bug in the client lib.

carla-m: SQL to identify impacted accounts: ``SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as raw_tokens, sum(tokens_deduped) as deduped_tokens FROM token_aggregates WHERE window='30m' AND processed_at > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY raw_tokens - deduped_tokens DESC LIMIT 100;`` Running now.

metering-bot: query job finished: 98 customers with delta > 1,000 tokens; top affected: cust_1302 (delta 45k), cust_42 (delta 21k).

alice-nguyen: dave-billing — please add these customers to a temporary credit-hold list and disable auto-invoice triggers for this window. We'll follow up with reconciliation once counts are corrected.

dave-billing: On it. Disabling auto-invoices for listed accounts now. Also pausing overage email policy for all accounts for the next 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

eve-support: Drafting a short customer message: "We observed an internal metering incident that may have caused incorrect overage notifications. We're investigating and have paused billing notifications while we reconcile. Apologies for the noise — we will follow up with account-level details." Want to post it to the affected customers in the next 30m.

alice-nguyen: Good. Technical mitigation next: can we replay the ingestion topic and re-run dedupe? If duplicates are still in kafka, reprocessing could fix counts in the aggregate store. Risk: double-apply if some dedupe already applied. Need idempotent dedupe key check.

bob-chen: We can run a targeted replay for affected customer partitions and run the aggregator in "reconciliation" mode which only writes deltas if event_id not seen. I will open a backfill job: backfill/2270011223-replay.

carla-m: Starting backfill job in staging (dry-run) to ensure no regressions. Command: ``./tools/backfill --topic metering-inbound --start 2026-03-15T08:45 --end 2026-03-15T09:10 --filter customers cust_1302,cust_42 --mode dry-run``

metering-bot: backfill dry-run results: would correct token totals for cust_1302 by -44,800 tokens, cust_42 by -20,900 tokens. No duplicate writes detected in dry-run.

alice-nguyen: ok proceed to controlled replay. plan: (a) small replay for top 3 customers to validate, (b) if green, expand to full affected set. Expected time for first batch: ~12min.

sre-oncall: Pushing hotfix to metering-agg canary now. Will monitor dedupe_failure_rate and downsteam commit logs.

bob-chen: note — we should also patch ingress client lib to ensure idempotency header is included on retry. I'll make a PR to fix the autoscaler image.

alice-nguyen: Operations note: incidence severity degrade to P3 once replay confirms counts and overage alerts suppressed. Still keep this channel open until reconciliation complete.

dave-billing: After replay, we will generate provisional credit memos for impacted accounts and coordinate QA with finance. Please don't issue refunds yet — create memo.

eve-support: Customer comms ready. Posting scheduled at T+30min with link to status page.

metering-bot: metering-agg canary deploy succeeded. dedupe_failure_rate back to 0.6% in canary region.

carla-m: first controlled replay completed for cust_1302 and cust_42. Aggregates show corrected counts; delta matches dry-run. No write conflicts.

alice-nguyen: Excellent. Expand to remaining affected accounts. Keep an eye on kafka offsets and consumer lag.

bob-chen: created PR #4839 to fix client idempotency for ingress. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra.

dave-billing: provisional memos created for 98 affected customers. Finance ok to issue credits after final reconciliation.

eve-support: Posted customer note and linked to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2270011223 — minor edits after QA.

alice-nguyen: Root cause summary (prelim): autoscaled ingress instance retried failed requests without idempotency header -> duplicate events into kafka -> dedupe pipeline didn't catch higher-than-expected duplicate rate due to recent config change -> inflated token counts -> automated overage flags.

alice-nguyen: Next steps: 1) merge client fix and roll to autoscaling group (bob). 2) Improve dedupe alerting thresholds and add synthetic tests for retry behavior (carla). 3) Run full reconciliation and close incident (sre-oncall). 4) Post-mortem doc draft (alice) with RCA, timeline, and credit plan.

sre-oncall: Moving to monitoring-only. I'll keep the channel open for any regressions.

eve-support: Closing loop: support will follow up with affected customers individually once finance confirms memos.

alice-nguyen: Thanks everyone. :heart: Filing postmortem task: PM-2270011223. Closing this thread after postmortem up.

incidents-bot: Incident updated to status MITIGATED at 2026-03-15T09:14:38Z. Severity changed to P3.
